item.title: Forest Grove community pantry brings groceries to immigrants afraid to leave their homes
item.description: A Forest Grove woman has turned her garage into a food pantry to provide food and other essential items to immigrant families in need who are too scared to leave their homes.

item.title: Cornelius man accused of raping, strangling child may have more victims, officials say
item.description: Alexis Jovanny Leyva-Lopez of Cornelius is facing multiple charges, including rape and sex abuse, after allegedly sexually assaulting a minor on Christmas Eve and driving them to a different location to commit the crime.

item.title: 'Most important thing': Portland businesses take part in national 'strike' against ICE
item.description: Businesses and students in Portland are protesting against ICE following two deaths at the hands of federal officers in Minneapolis, with some businesses closing and others donating a portion of their sales to the Portland Immigrant Rights Coalition.
